name: inhouse-eventify
description: Run API + web app together (MongoDB must be running for the API).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start:stack: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
